controls.method: Original find_duplicate_media/get_media_size/_has_matching_children AST methods, synthetic Plex/filter objects; no GUI or account

findings: Same movie titles overwrite previously collected distinct movie groups; distinct-title positive control retains both groups. Titles are identity keys rather than Plex rating keys/library identifiers.
Multipart media size aggregates both parts but file path stores first part only, demonstrated with10+20byte synthetic metadata.
Empty title filter causes _has_matching_children to return true before checking codec filter; demonstrated h264 child with h265 filter.
Hardlink-mode toggle updates interface but process_deletions calls _perform_deletions; no route to _perform_hardlinks found in fully read source. Source-only, not GUI execution.
Filters reconstruct Treeview from cached item dictionaries; manual KEEP/DELETE changes after snapshot can be overwritten by later filters. Runtime adapter not yet executed for this case.
Version text and parent display title resolve deletion targets; no stable identity stored directly on UI rows.
Physical-file delete exceptions are logged but do not increment outer error_count; full GUI outcome not executed.
limits: No whole GUI/Plex session/deletion/hardlink conversion or performance proof. Native pHash/ASAN deferred.
